title: Senior Buyer (Oil&Gas)
description:
Responsible for procurement of materials,equipment,and services required for the day-to-day operation and maintenance of Oil & Gas facilities,plants,terminals,utilities,and associated infrastructure . 

Monitor supplier performance covering quality,delivery,cost,documentation,warranty and contractual compliance,and take corrective action where required

Experience: 12 to 20 Years

Key Skills: Purchase,Maintenance Management,Contract Management,Vendor Negotiation,IT Procurement,Contract Negotiations,Procurement Management
